svg.title: Vigil - SOC detection lab and incident response
svg.desc: Wazuh, TheHive and OpenSearch lab. A four-stage web app compromise (SQL injection, XSS, IDOR, simulated ransomware), each stage detected in Wazuh, escalated to TheHive and closed with a written verdict.

g.text: Wazuh, TheHive and OpenSearch lab. A four-stage web app compromise, each
stage detected, escalated and closed with a verdict.
